pages.ko: 밤이 되면 엄마가 칫솔을 살랑살랑 흔들며 노래해요. "우리 호리, 이 닦고 코~ 잘 시간!" 그런데 호리는 이불 속으로 쏙— "양치 안 할래, 귀찮단 말이야!" 하고 눈을 꼭 감아요.
pages.t: When night comes, Mom waves the toothbrush and sings, "Time for our Hori to brush his teeth and go to sleep!" But Hori slips right under the blanket — "I don't want to brush, it's such a bother!" — and shuts his eyes tight.

pages.ko: 엄마가 칫솔을 내밀어도 호리는 고개를 절레절레, 도리도리. "딱 한 번만 안 하면 안 돼?" 결국 호리는 양치를 건너뛰고 쿨쿨 잠들었어요.
pages.t: Even when Mom held out the toothbrush, Hori shook his head, no, no. "Can't I skip it just this once?" In the end, Hori skipped brushing and fell fast asleep.

pages.ko: 그런데 자다가— 어라? 이가 텁텁하고 근질근질! "이 사이가 이상해…" 낮에 먹은 과자 부스러기가 이 사이에 콕 숨어 근질거려요. 호리는 볼을 만지며 눈을 떴어요.
pages.t: But while he was sleeping — huh? His teeth felt fuzzy and itchy! "Something feels weird between my teeth..." A cookie crumb from the afternoon snack was hiding between his teeth, making them itch. Hori touched his cheek and opened his eyes.

pages.ko: 눈을 뜬 호리에게 엄마가 조르르 다가왔어요. "이 사이에 숨은 충치벌레가 장난친 거야. 우리 같이 쫓아내자!" 엄마가 호리 손을 꼭 잡아요.
pages.t: Mom hurried over to Hori as soon as he woke up. "A cavity bug hiding between your teeth has been causing mischief. Let's chase it away together!" Mom held Hori's hand tight.

pages.ko: 엄마가 상상 이야기를 시작하자, 호리 눈앞에 그림이 그려졌어요. 하얀 이 위에서 보라색 충치벌레들이 데굴데굴 뒹굴며 낄낄 웃어요. "저 녀석들이 이를 콕콕 찌른 거구나!"
pages.t: As Mom began her imaginative story, a picture appeared before Hori's eyes. On his white teeth, purple cavity bugs were rolling around, giggling. "So those little guys are the ones poking at my teeth!"

pages.ko: "충치벌레는 치약 거품을 제일 무서워해!" 엄마가 속닥였어요. 칫솔은 호리의 반짝이 검, 치약 거품은 마법 방울! 호리 눈이 반짝 빛났어요.
pages.t: "Cavity bugs are most afraid of toothpaste bubbles!" Mom whispered. The toothbrush is Hori's sparkling sword, and the toothpaste bubbles are magic drops! Hori's eyes lit up.

pages.ko: 호리는 벌떡 일어나 세면대로 갔어요. 칫솔에 치약을 콕! 위로 쓱, 아래로 쓱, 뽀글뽀글 거품이 몽글몽글! 충치벌레들이 눈이 뱅글뱅글 돌며 도망쳐요. 치카치카 쓱쓱, 반짝반짝!
pages.t: Hori jumped up and hopped to the sink. A dab of toothpaste on the brush! Swish up, swish down, bubbles foaming and frothing! The cavity bugs went dizzy and ran away. Brush brush, scrub scrub, sparkling clean!

pages.ko: 입을 헹구고 "아—" 하고 벌리자, 이가 반짝반짝! 근질거리던 느낌도 씻은 듯 사라졌어요. 그 순간 호리 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 부릉! 해냈어요!
pages.t: He rinsed his mouth and opened wide, "Ahh —" and his teeth sparkled and shone! The itchy feeling washed away completely. In that moment, the stripes on Hori's tail flashed rainbow colors — whoosh! He did it!

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 규칙을 알아요. 하나, 아침에 일어나면 치카치카! 둘, 자기 전에 또 치카치카! 셋, 위로 쓱 아래로 쓱 골고루! 다음 날 아침, 호리가 먼저 칫솔을 집었어요. 치카치카 쓱쓱, 반짝반짝!
pages.t: Now Hori knows the rules. One, brush brush when you wake up in the morning! Two, brush brush again before bed! Three, swish up and down, all around! The next morning, Hori picked up his toothbrush first. Brush brush, scrub scrub, sparkling clean!

pages.ko: 엄마가 호리를 꼭 안아 주었어요. "우리 호리 이가 별처럼 반짝이네!" 이제 호리는 알아요. 매일 치카치카하면 충치벌레는 얼씬도 못 한다는 걸. 치카치카 쓱쓱, 반짝반짝!
pages.t: Mom hugged Hori tight. "Our Hori's teeth are sparkling like stars!" Now Hori knows that if you brush every day, cavity bugs can't come anywhere near. Brush brush, scrub scrub, sparkling clean!

overview.ko: 양치를 미루던 호리가 충치를 겪고 의사 선생님과 약속하며 매일 양치하게 되는 생활동화입니다.
overview.t: This is a life-habits story about Hori, who used to put off brushing his teeth, experiencing a cavity and making a promise to the dentist to start brushing every day.

lessons.t: Build the habit of brushing after meals and snacks.
Learn the importance of keeping a promise.

readingTips.ko: '치카치카 뽀득' 후렴을 칫솔질 흉내와 함께 읽어 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read the "brush brush, squeaky clean" refrain together while acting out brushing motions.
It's most effective to read this together right before brushing time.
